text: Users can create an account, deploy a GPU, and run code on it remotely
quote: Follow this guide to learn how to create an account, deploy your first GPU, and use it to execute code remotely.

text: Public Endpoints give instant API access to pre-deployed image/video/audio/text models with no deployment needed
quote: Runpod offers Public Endpoints for instant API access to pre-deployed AI models for image, video, audio, and text generation. No deployment or infrastructure required

text: Runpod provides official MCP servers so AI tools and coding agents can connect directly to Runpod
quote: Runpod provides two Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that connect AI tools and coding agents directly to Runpod

text: Instant Clusters offer fully managed multi-node GPU compute with high-performance networking for distributed jobs
quote: Instant Clusters provide fully managed multi-node compute with high-performance networking for distributed workloads. Deploy jobs or large-scale without managing infrastructure, networking, or cluster configuration.

text: Runpod CLI lets you manage pods, endpoints, templates, volumes, models, transfer files, and view account info locally
quote: You can manage Pods, Serverless endpoints, templates, network volumes, and models, transfer files between your system and Runpod, diagnose issues, and view account information.

text: SSH gives secure, reliable, full shell access to a Pod for long-running processes
quote: SSH provides secure, reliable access to your Pod for long-running processes and full shell capabilities.

text: An S3-compatible API lets you manage network volume files without launching a Pod, cutting cost and friction
quote: Runpod provides an S3-protocol compatible API for direct access to your network volumes. This allows you to manage files on your network volumes without launching a Pod, reducing cost and operational friction.

text: A REST API v1 provides programmatic access to all Runpod compute resources for integration into apps and automation
quote: The Runpod REST API v1 provides programmatic access to all Runpod compute resources. Integrate GPU infrastructure into your applications, workflows, and automation systems.

text: Coding agents can auto-migrate legacy CLI calls to the REST API via a '/runpod:migrate rest' skill command
quote: To migrate automatically, ask your coding agent to run `/runpod:migrate rest` once you've installed the Runpod skills plugin.

text: Official PyTorch templates let you skip manual environment setup and get a ready-to-use instance instantly
quote: Instead of installing PyTorch, configuring JupyterLab, and setting up all dependencies yourself, you can select an official Runpod PyTorch template and have everything ready to go instantly.

text: 3-month or 6-month upfront commitments unlock significant discounts on compute costs
quote: Commit to a 3-month or 6-month term upfront for significant discounts on compute costs.

text: AI agents can be asked in natural language to create Pods, deploy Serverless endpoints, transfer files, or deploy code with Flash
quote: Once installed, you can ask your agent to create Pods, deploy Serverless endpoints, transfer files, or deploy your own code with Flash, all in natural language.

text: Auto-pay automatically reloads account balance below a threshold to avoid service interruptions
quote: Auto-pay automatically reloads your account balance when it falls below a threshold, helping you avoid service interruptions from low funds.

text: Pods can be accessed via SSH, web proxy, JupyterLab, or VS Code/Cursor IDE integration
quote: you can connect to your Pod through SSH for command-line access, web proxy for exposed web services, JupyterLab for data science workflows, or VS Code/Cursor for local IDE integration

text: Python functions can be run on remote GPUs directly from the local terminal
quote: Run Python functions on remote GPUs directly from your local terminal.

text: Network volumes provide persistent storage independent of compute, surviving termination/scale-to-zero and shareable across machines
quote: Network volumes provide persistent storage that exists independently of your compute resources. Data is retained when terminate or scale to zero. Use them to share data across multiple machines and Runpod products.

text: Serverless workers are billed per-second only while running, with no upfront costs
quote: Serverless offers pay-per-second pricing with no upfront costs. You're billed from when a worker starts until it fully stops, rounded up to the nearest second.

text: Custom containers can be pulled from any compatible registry (Docker Hub, GitHub Container Registry, Amazon ECR)
quote: Custom containers: Pull from any compatible container registry such as Docker Hub, GitHub Container Registry, or Amazon ECR.

text: Flex workers scale to zero on idle at standard rate, while Active workers stay running 24/7
quote: Flex workers | Scale to zero when idle | ... | Active workers | Always running (24/7)

text: Secure Cloud partners are vetted to meet SOC 2, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS enterprise security standards
quote: Secure Cloud provides vetted infrastructure partners who meet enterprise security standards including SOC 2, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS certifications.

text: Secure Cloud runs in T3/T4 data centers for enterprise reliability, while Community Cloud offers a vetted peer-to-peer marketplace
quote: Secure Cloud: Operates in T3/T4 data centers, providing high reliability and security for enterprise and production workloads. Community Cloud: Connects individual compute providers to users through a vetted, secure peer-to-peer system, wit

text: Thousands of GPUs are available across 30+ regions worldwide
quote: Thousands of GPUs across 30+ regions. Simple pricing plans for teams of all sizes, designed to scale with you.

text: REST API manages pods, endpoints, templates, volumes, and registries, authenticated via API key or Sign-in with Runpod
quote: Manage Pods, endpoints, templates, volumes, and registries through the Runpod REST API. Authenticate with Sign in with Runpod or a Runpod API key

text: Pods can be created, started, stopped, and terminated via the console or CLI
quote: Create, start, stop, and terminate Pods using the Runpod console or CLI.

text: Multi-node training lets you train models too large for one GPU or accelerate training across nodes
quote: Train models too large for one GPU, or accelerate training across multiple nodes.

text: Pods are billed by the second for compute and storage with no data ingress/egress fees
quote: Pods are billed by the second for compute and storage, with no fees for data ingress or egress.

text: FlashBoot or model caching can minimize serverless cold-start times
quote: Minimize with FlashBoot or model caching.
